```hcl
  description = "application servers"

  ingress {
    description = "SSH for admin access"
    from_port   = 22
    to_port     = 22
    protocol    = "tcp"
    # Restricted to a specific internal network or admin IP range
    cidr_blocks = ["10.0.0.0/16"]
  }
}
```
